summary: The exclusive disk ownership check skips another domain's disk source that does not exist instead of refusing, so an unmounted repository no longer blocks changes to unrelated VMs; every other stat error still refuses (BUG-0191). API impact: none — Core-internal validation; command results and errors are unchanged apart from removing the false refusal.

guide.reason: No operator workflow changes; a VM edit or media change that was falsely refused now proceeds.

api.reason: API impact: none. vm-create, vm-update and media commands keep their payloads, results and error set; only a false internal refusal is removed.

roadmap.reason: Bug fix within existing VM storage safety checks.

state.reason: No durable state added or changed.

verification.method: go test -race ./internal/vmhost -run TestExclusiveDisk (new test failed before the fix with 'other domain disk cannot be inspected for exclusive ownership', passes after); go test -race ./internal/vmhost.
